title: [Shopify] Upgrade tax matching to GPT-5.6 Ceres
summary: Shopify tax matching agent upgrades from GPT-4.1 to GPT-5.6 Ceres, a newer managed model version. The change selects a different model while keeping all other components like chat completions, temperature, token limits, and validation behavior the same.
key_points: Shopify tax matching now calls GetGPT56CeresLatest() instead of GetGPT41Latest()
Chat Completions, forced function calling, temperature 0, token limit and capability registration are unchanged
Matching proposals may differ because of the new model
Existing structured-response validation and human review gates stay in place
No schema, permission or data migration changes
quote: Upgrade Shopify tax matching from GPT-4.1 to the latest managed GPT-5.6 Ceres deployment by replacing `GetGPT41Latest()` with `GetGPT56CeresLatest()`.
